build_init_distributed_environment: initialize the distributed environment with world size, rank, and backend for multi-GPU training
create_initialize_model_parallel: initialize model parallel groups for tensor, sequence, pipeline, data, and CFG parallelism
test_model_parallel_is_initialized: check if all model parallel groups (TP, SP, PP, DP, CFG) are properly initialized
run_destroy_model_parallel: destroy all model parallel groups and reset them to uninitialized state
build_is_the_same_node_as: test if processes are on the same node using shared memory detection across a process group
